title: Effect of strontium on the performance of Ni/CBV20A catalyst in partial oxidation of methane for syngas and hydrogen production
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8471-8479
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06426G, Paper
Open Access

Abdulaziz Al-Anazi, Marie-Nour Kaydouh, Omer Bellahwel, Ahmed A. Ibrahim, Abdulaziz A. M. Abahussain, Vijay Kumar Srivastava, Anis H. Fakeeha, Naif S. Almuqati, Raja Alotaibi, Ahmed S. Al-Fatesh, Nissrine El Hassan
The addition of Sr to Ni5/CBV20A catalyst improves CH4 conversion and H2/CO ratio, even under severe conditions. This addition promotes the direct POM pathway at low GHSV while the indirect pathway becomes more prominent at high GHSV.
